newsitem.title: UK: Rover to expand Land Rover production.
newsitem.headline: Rover to expand Land Rover production.

text.p: German-owned Rover group, the British car manufacturer, said on Thursday that it planned to significantly increase the production of its Land Rover vehicles.
In 1997 Rover, owned by BMW, plans to build 131,451 Land Rovers, up from 128,000 built in 1996, Ian Robertson, a key official at Rover's Land Rover Vehicles unit told German journalists.
He added that the group planned to produce 180,000 Land Rover vehicles next year 1998.
Particular growth would be seen in the new smaller off-road vehicle, which will be launched this fall and has the working title "CB40".
Some 4,000 to 5,000 "CB40" vehicles would be built this year with maximum capacity reaching 60,000 vehicles next year, the group said.
